intro: The preview is a separate install and cannot read 3.x's data. Import your follows and settings from 3.x or another device, or just start.
fromFileSubtitle: A file exported by 3.x's Backup and restore, or a v4 backup
fromWebdavSubtitle: A backup you uploaded to Jianguoyun, Nextcloud or another drive
fromDeviceSubtitle: Sent by another device on the same network with LAN sync
laterHint: You can import any time later under Me › Backup and sync.
crashPrompt: Something went wrong last time. Export a diagnostics bundle and attach it to a problem report to help find the cause.
